---
title: "GitHub"
---

GitHub is the remote collaboration and recovery location for pushed Git
repositories. Store source code, documentation, text-based projects, and
versioned configuration in repositories under a local directory such as
`~/repos`.

Commit or stash important work and push branches that must not remain
local-only. GitHub does not back up uncommitted work, ignored files, local-only
branches, or unrelated workstation folders.
